scope: Original 3.9 solver fixture and actual current numerical solver. Historical recomputation is not execution of the old solver. No graphics or human driving acceptance.

evidence.name: Actual published 3.9 source record is retained and explicitly recomputed without relabelling it as exact replay

migration.defaultStateMeaning: No default physical or controller state was added. Full historical state and collision signature must match the current contract.
migration.preserved: All historical parameters (including climbRateMps), rigid body, wheels, gas, valves, controller state, disturbance phase, observation buffers and seed.
migration.limitation: The 3.9.0 solver is not executed. The current model recalculates the explicitly mapped initial state; this is never an exact old-model replay.

evidence.name: Incompatible collision worlds, parameter/state contracts and unimplemented model versions refuse execution
